difficulty_reason: A composition of perfect morphisms of schemes is perfect. The retained proof translates to ring maps A -> B -> C perfect: pseudo-coherence of the composite was established in the in-source composition-pseudo-coherent lemma, and finite tor dimension is new content — if B has tor dimension <= n over A and C has tor dimension <= m over B, then for every A-module M the associativity triangle M x_A^L C = (M x_A^L B) x_B^L C plus the spectral sequence of More on Algebra, example-tor, gives Tor_p^A(M, C) = 0 for p > n + m. Retained author proof at lines 17764-17780.
